TASK 1 (Natural Medium-Grey Studio Portrait / Gri Fon): Using the framing-corrected portrait and all original reference photos of this person above, produce a natural head-and-shoulders studio portrait on a flat medium-grey studio background matching Bilgehan's studio backdrop (NOT pure white, NOT black). 1. NO stiff biometric/ID rules: preserve the person's natural head angle, posture, authentic expression/smile, hairstyle or headscarf wrap, glasses (if worn), and clothing from their framing-corrected photo.

3. Head-and-shoulders framing with comfortable headroom above the hair/headscarf and both shoulders visible. If a hand is raised to the face/hair in a selfie, remove/lower the hand cleanly.
4. Soft, even professional studio lighting on the subject that matches the medium-grey backdrop, sharp focus across the subject, no shallow depth-of-field blur, no text or logos. 
Person details: Academic advisor (Associate Professor). Round-oval face, short dark hair with slight curl on top, full short dark beard and moustache, warm smile, wearing dark suit jacket, light blue shirt, and dark blue tie.
